summary: M10 remains safely bounded away from live execution, but its exactly-once commit protocol, signal-session semantics, filesystem trust boundary and synthetic/resource enforcement are not implementation-ready.
blockers: Exactly-once reservation, commit and crash-recovery protocol is incomplete.
Signal datetime, trading session and scheduled-cycle relationship is incomplete.
Filesystem path and immutable-input trust boundaries are incomplete.
Synthetic identity and bounded-input enforcement are incomplete.
